evals.prompt: 放首歌，打开 Spotify 搜 Circles 然后播放
evals.expected_output: Spotify reached foreground via spotify://search/circles; the top matching row is tapped; the playback bar shows the track and the play button reads 'pause' (verification marker hit). No API key or OAuth involved.

assertions.text: opens Spotify via a spotify:// deep link
confirms playback with a pause-button marker

evals.prompt: 搜一首歌：连名带姓 张惠妹 然后播第一首
evals.expected_output: Deep link spotify://search/连名带姓%20张惠妹 (percent-encoded CJK) opens Spotify; the first song row matching the query is located and tapped; playback verified by marker.

assertions.text: percent-encodes the CJK query in the deep link

evals.prompt: 打开微信朋友圈，随便滑一滑
evals.expected_output: weixin:// deep link brings WeChat foreground; since Moments hides its tree from accessibility, the skill performs human-like random swipes instead of trying to dump/tap inner nodes; it does NOT guess button coordinates.

assertions.text: falls back to gesture swipes when the app tree is unavailable

evals.prompt: 打开一个没有前台的 app，比如一个没装的 app
evals.expected_output: open_and_verify returns ok=false with a clear error; the skill surfaces the failure instead of pretending the action succeeded.

assertions.text: surfaces open failure instead of claiming success
